aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid changed-condition rows but misgroups outcomes and invents or misreads several metrics.
issues: No explicit baseline condition is cited.
Function defect results omit actual Total NG and NG Rate values.
Measurement outcome is derived from headers and mixed count/ratio rows, not valid stats.
Sheet1 before/after/hearing-voltage context is not integrated or excluded with reason.
Changed factor may be three process trials, not one baseline-vs-test comparison.
requiredUserQuestions: Is there a normal or baseline lot outside the cited rows?
Should the three VP+CD process settings be compared against each other or only reported as trials?
Are Sheet1 before/after voltage measurements part of this review case?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed-factor grouping from Function rows 3-10.
Set baseline as unknown unless a normal condition is found.
Extract Hearing +1V and +0V Noise, Touch, Total NG, and NG Rate per trial.
Remove invalid measurement stats based only on headers.
Review Sheet1 numeric rows before deciding inclusion.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are sufficient for changed conditions but insufficient for current derived outcomes.
